import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long INF = (long) 1e15;
    static final int MX = 1000010;
    static List<Long> ones = new ArrayList<>();
    static int answer = MX;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        // Initialize ones with 0
        ones.add(0L);
        // Generate ones: 1, 11, 111, ..., up to 16 times
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; i++) {
            long last = ones.get(ones.size() - 1);
            ones.add(last * 10 + 1);
        }

        search(n, 0);
        System.out.println(answer);
        sc.close();
    }

    static void search(long x, int vv) {
        if (vv > answer)
            return;
        if (x == 0) {
            answer = vv;
            return;
        }
        int lbIndex = lowerBound(ones, x);
        int ubIndex = upperBound(ones, x);
        if (lbIndex == ubIndex)
            lbIndex--;
        long lbVal = ones.get(lbIndex);
        long rem = x - lbVal;
        int cost = lbIndex;
        long ubVal = ones.get(ubIndex);
        long rem2 = ubVal - x;
        // Recurse with x % lbVal
        search(x % lbVal, vv + cost * (x / lbVal));
        // Recurse with rem2
        search(rem2, vv + cost + 1);
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0;
        int high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key)
                high = mid;
            else
                low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }

    static int upperBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0;
        int high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) > key)
                high = mid;
            else
                low = mid + 1;
        }
        return low;
    }
}
